text_block_list.text: One day after school—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I promised to go hang out with Teio after this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah, if you've already got plans, don't worry about it.
Just make sure you don't stay out too late!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I'd love to help, but I promised a friend I'd teach them French...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's totally fine, nothing to apologize for.
Go out there and be a great teacher!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And well, that's pretty much it! If you don't mind,
would you come with me to the flash sale?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Today is the monthly big bargain sale day,
where all meat is 30% off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you busy too?
Truth is, I've already been turned down a few times!
Guess asking for today was pretty sudden, though—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The usual shopping district is fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah!!
...Wait, you'll actually come with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What, you know you want me to come.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, please come, by all means!!
Still... never hurts to ask, does it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... What is it now?
On this day, Narita Brian practically dragged me along to help her with shopping, and we arrived at the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
...Wait, did you bring your Trainer along too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The more hands on deck, the better.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, yeah. Well, that's true!
Even so—
(Murmur, murmur... Chatter, chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It really is a sale—
the store is totally packed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... Cold feet? That's not like you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What kind of nonsense is that!?
You think Big Sis Hishiama would get scared by something like this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Right. So, how do we attack this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, of course, a head-on approach!!

And so, working together, the two of them
successfully managed to score the discounted meat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad you were here!
There's no way I could've done this alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If I'd known it was gonna be this rough,
I wouldn't have offered to help...

Hishi Ama-cha~n!
Hishi Ama-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I got back early just like you asked~☆
Here to help out with Laurel-san—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh... Brian-chan is helping out?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya might just be super surprised!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: To think such a thing could happen...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, I've been keeping quiet and listening for a while now, but every last one of you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're the one who came to me for help in the first place... Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Can't be helped, right?
Call it the fruits of our daily conduct.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, it's true we were in the wrong too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's our fault for not realizing sooner
that you're actually pretty great company.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Brian-chan, okay?
I'm sooorry...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
I'm usually the one causing trouble for you anyway...
choice_data_list: The power of meat is incredible.
The power of meat really is incredible, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
I'm usually the one causing trouble for you anyway...
choice_data_list: The power of meat is incredible.
The power of meat really is incredible, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm always honest...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're always way too honest.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Her likes and dislikes are very easy to tell.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maya knows!
Brian-san's likes and dislikes~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm always taking notes~☆
Wanna hear what I wrote?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't come crying to me for help later, you hear...
...and just like that, Narita Brian walked away from the scene like a petulant child.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Meat...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hahaha, I get it now!
Part of it was just that you wanted to eat meat, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No... It's just because I was free—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Come now, as thanks, I'll make sure your next bento has extra meat!
Narita Brian showed an utterly transparent reaction.
